name: Ellis
description: A man in his mid thirties who sings warm seventies soul ballads, easygoing and quietly confident on stage.
build: An average, balanced adult build of ordinary proportions: medium shoulders, a relaxed straight torso, a natural waist, and arms and legs of ordinary length and thickness, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Deep brown skin, dark brown eyes under thick straight black brows, a broad nose, rounded cheekbones, a short neat black beard along the jaw, and full lips.
hair: Short tightly coiled black hair in a rounded natural shape about two inches deep, evenly textured over the whole head and clear of the ears and forehead.
outfit: A chunky forest-green rib-knit roll-neck sweater with wide bold vertical ribs, fitted at the body, the cuffs ending at the wrists so both hands are fully bare; slate-grey heavy wool trousers, straight-legged, ending at the ankle; a wide cognac-tan leather belt with a large square polished brass buckle at the centre of the waist; cognac-tan leather Chelsea boots with plain rounded toes and elastic side panels in slate grey. His head is bare.
performance_style: Easy and upright: feet hip-width apart, weight even on both boots. Both arms hang relaxed at his sides, the character-right and character-left hands open, empty, fingers loose and fully visible beside the thighs. Head level, a calm closed-mouth smile.
location: A small late-night listening room, seen from the front of a low stage of warm honey-coloured floorboards running to the bottom of the frame: a back wall of dark walnut panelling, a tall potted fern at one side, a bare wooden stool pushed against the wall, and a row of round amber pendant lamps overhead casting soft warm pools onto the panelling.
recognition_cues: a chunky forest-green rib-knit roll-neck sweater
a wide cognac leather belt with a large square brass buckle
short tightly coiled black hair and a short black beard
avoid: a cardigan, jacket or coat over the sweater

sing.intent: Soul-ballad vocal loop: settle the weight, bring the mic in the character-right hand up to the mouth for a long held phrase, open the character-left hand outward at chest height on the swell, then lower the mic to the chest and return to the easy upright stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief surprise at a loud room sound: the shoulders lift, the torso draws back slightly and both open hands rise to chest height, then he settles back to the easy upright stance. No opponent, strike or physical contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: step the feet a little wider, bring the character-left forearm across the chest with the character-right hand open at the hip, then hold a steady grounded finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: stroll in with an unhurried step, turn square to the front, then land upright with the feet hip-width apart and both open hands relaxed at his sides.
